title: Superpower closer
description: A closing photo band: a small rating line, a big two-line white headline, a row of small check facts and two pills (white and frosted) at the top left over warm, dark photography. On desktop the photo keeps running behind whatever you pass as children (the footer), which floats over it as an inset card; on phones the band is 512px and the children follow below it.
notes: the band forces the dark class on itself; children (the footer) keep the page's own mode
pass superpower-footer as children to get the original's floating footer card on desktop
name: superpower-closer
